Madnesses heat me, and the goad of the gadfly, fireless, anoints me; my heart kicks my mind with fear, and my eyes whirl in circles. I am carried out of the course of frenzy by a raging blast, without control of my tongue; and turbid words strike at random.
HEPHAESTUS: I groan over your labors. KRATOS: But you shrink back and groan over the enemies of Zeus?
IO: Alas, alas! PROMETHEUS: But you cry out again—
May it be so; but explain the rest to your friends.

PROMETHEUS: You would be pleased, I think—. IO: How could I not, who—
IO: A marriage ordained by god or mortal? PROMETHEUS: What do you mean, which one?
